annotations.title: HTTP status code meaning: explain what an HTTP status code means

description: Name and plain-language meaning of an HTTP status code (1xx-5xx, including 402 Payment Required and 429 Too Many Requests), and whether to retry. Use when handling API errors. Example: code=429. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
